message: No detected input validation: The code reads files and processes data without any schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards on the incoming data.

No detected untrusted source handling: The code fetches models from HuggingFace Hub (AutoTokenizer, AutoModel with 'vinai/phobert-base') without pinning a commit revision, verifying checksums, or authenticating the source.

No detected label flipping detection: The code only encodes labels via index lookup (label_encode) without any distribution comparison, validation against an expected set, or label-noise detection tools.
No detected data poisoning defenses: There are no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering mechanisms applied to training samples anywhere in the data preparation code.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads 'vinai/phobert-base' via AutoModel.from_pretrained and AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision/commit hash.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous samples before or during training; labels are loaded and used directly.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no activation analysis, gradient anomaly detection, or any other backdoor/trigger defense in the training loop.
No detected differential privacy: The code uses standard AdamW optimization with no differential privacy library (Opacus, TF Privacy, DP-SGD) or noise-addition mechanism.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or robustness stress tests are present anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: Although a separate test dataset is loaded, there is no hashing/signing of evaluation data, no isolation enforcement beyond a simple split, and only two metrics (accuracy and macro F1) are computed with no independent verification mechanism.

No detected input sanitization: The inference/data path performs no shape, range, or schema validation on incoming inputs before passing them to the model; tokenization and padding happen without any guards against malformed or adversarial inputs.
No detected output bounds checks: Model outputs are passed directly through softmax and returned with no NaN checks, probability sanity bounds, or threshold validation anywhere in the visible code.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a sentiment classification model (not a generative LLM), so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable, and none are implemented.
